# About Lantern Supply Co.

Last updated: October 1, 2026
Owner: Priya Whitcomb-Nair

Lantern Supply Co. sells camping lanterns, oil lamps, fuel and parts from two showrooms in
Maryland and from the online store at lanternsupply.example. We make some of what we sell, we
repair everything we sell, and we have been doing both since 1987. This page is the short version
of who we are, for new employees and for customers who ask.

## The story

Marjorie and Dale Whitcomb opened the first store in 1987 in a former hardware shop at 412 East
Patrick Street in Frederick, Maryland, the same building we occupy today. Dale had repaired
pressure lanterns for the Boy Scouts for years and could not find a shop that would sell a decent
oil lamp or a spare mantle; Marjorie ran the books and the counter. The first product with our
name on it was the Heritage No. 7 brass oil lamp, which Dale designed and had made by a brass
spinner in Baltimore, and which we still sell with a 10-year warranty.

For the first ten years the business was lamps, wicks, fuel and repairs. In 2003 the company
assembled its first Hagerstown Kerosene Lantern in a rented bay in Hagerstown, and in 2009 it
sold its first LED lantern, the Firefly 100. The online store opened in 2011. The Annapolis
showroom opened in May 2014, and in 2016 the warehouse and Repair Center moved into the current
building at 1180 Downsville Pike in Hagerstown, with the loading dock at Dock B that every return
and repair comes through.

[2] about.md > The company
## Second Light

Lanterns that come back as returns or trade-ins and pass a bench inspection are sold as Second
Light refurbished items, at a discount, with a 1-year warranty. Second Light items are sold at
both showrooms and, a few times a year, online. The program keeps good lanterns out of landfills
and gives a scout troop or a student a Sentinel at a Firefly price.

## The company

Lantern Supply Co. is a Maryland corporation, privately held and family owned. The fiscal year
runs from February 1 to January 31. The company has no outside investors and no debt beyond the
mortgage on the Hagerstown building.

Last updated: September 8, 2026
Owner: Beth Carrow, People Operations Manager

This excerpt covers the sections of the Lantern Supply Co. employee handbook that new hires ask
about most: hours, pay, time off, benefits, the employee discount, dress code, expenses, fuel

## Welcome

Lantern Supply Co. was founded in 1987 by Marjorie and Dale Whitcomb in Frederick, Maryland, and
is still owned and run by the family. Priya Whitcomb-Nair, the founders' daughter, has been chief
executive since 2019. As of October 2026 there are 63 of us across the Frederick headquarters and
showroom, the Annapolis showroom and the Hagerstown warehouse and Repair Center. We are a small
company that sells a small range of things well. Most of the people who buy from us are repeat
customers, and most of them know a great deal about lanterns. Treat them that way.

[4] shipping.md > Where we ship
## Carriers

Standard orders ship by UPS Ground or USPS, chosen by the warehouse management system by weight
and destination. As a rule, packages under 1 lb go USPS and everything else goes UPS Ground.
Expedited orders ship UPS 2nd Day Air. Overnight orders ship UPS Next Day Air Saver. Canadian
orders ship UPS Standard to Canada.

The warehouse can ship by FedEx on request for a customer who cannot receive UPS, at the UPS
rate; this is set up by Denise Okafor's team on a per-order basis.

Carrier pickups are at 4:30 PM each business day. The UPS account number and the USPS permit are
held by the warehouse office; agents do not need them.

## Where we ship

Lantern Supply Co. ships to all 50 US states and to Canada. The company does not ship to any
other country, to US territories, or to APO/FPO addresses. Customers outside the United States
and Canada are referred to the authorized retailer list on the website.

### Canada

Canadian orders cost a flat $19.95 and take 5 to 10 business days. Duties, GST/HST and any
brokerage fee are paid by the recipient on delivery; the company does not collect them and cannot
estimate them. Fuel does not ship to Canada. Shipping to Canada was added with Hearth 4.2 on
August 11, 2026; before that, Canadian customers ordered by phone and paid actual carrier cost.

### How do I replace a broken Beacon 600 globe?

Order globe G-600 for $14.99. Unscrew the top cap, lift the old globe off the posts, set the new
one in place and screw the cap back on; it takes about two minutes and no tools. Keep the rubber
gasket under the cap, as a new globe does not come with one.

### Do you sell refurbished lanterns?

Yes. Lanterns that come back and pass a bench inspection at the Repair Center are sold as Second
Light refurbished items at a discount, with a 1-year warranty. They are sold at both showrooms
and a few times a year online.
